extracted.intended_audience: people shopping for a used 2019 Toyota Camry in Seattle, WA (used-car buyers)
extracted.subtask_description: A marketplace listing page that aggregates used 2019 Toyota Camry vehicles for sale (Seattle, WA) with filters, pricing, vehicle details, features, and owner reviews to help shoppers compare options. The page is focused on listing/filtering/searching and summarizing inventory and typical specs/features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Price / List Price
rubrics_metrics.description: LIST PRICE (e.g., $10,950, $23,499, etc.). Prices for a used 2019 Toyota Camry in Seattle, WA currently range from $1,909 to $99,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed per-listing; page also provides min/max price filters (many incremental values) and aggregate price range. Listings include a price-qualifier like 'Excellent price', 'Great price', 'Fair price', or 'High price' to indicate relative value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Price-quality label
rubrics_metrics.description: Per-listing qualitative labels that describe price relative to market: 'Excellent price', 'Great price', 'Fair price', 'High price'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to quickly flag deals; no numeric threshold given on page but used consistently alongside list price. Helpful for shoppers to triage listings without manual market comparisons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mileage
rubrics_metrics.description: Per-listing odometer reading (e.g., 'Used · 181,200 mi') and mileage filter options (Any, 5,000 or less, 10,000 or less, ... Over 150,000).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown on each listing and usable as a filter; important for evaluating wear and remaining life. Sorting options include Mileage Low to High and Mileage High to Low.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vehicle condition / history indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Badges/filters: 'CPO (certified pre-owned)', 'No accidents reported', 'Clean title only', 'One owner'. Vehicle history data is provided by Experian AutoCheck.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filters and per-listing badges indicate accident history and title status. Page notes 'Vehicle history data is provided by Experian AutoCheck. Use of this data is subject to the AutoCheck Terms & Conditions.' These are procedural criteria buyers commonly use to assess risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) status
rubrics_metrics.description: CPO (certified pre-owned) is exposed as a filter/condition option.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CPO indicates dealer/manufacturer certification and is presented separately from other condition badges (accident-free, clean title). Buyers may prioritize CPO listings for warranty/inspection benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Features / options availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Per-listing features shown (examples on page): 'Adaptive Cruise Control', 'Apple CarPlay', 'Backup Camera', 'Bluetooth', 'Front Heated Seats', 'Lane Keep Assist', 'Multi-Zone Climate Control', 'Premium Wheels', 'Blind Spot System', 'Premium Seat Material', 'Moonroof', 'Premium Audio', 'Remote Engine Start', etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Features are listed per-vehicle and are also summarized across inventory (e.g., 'Based on TrueCar’s inventory, used 2019 Toyota Camry listings usually offer Bluetooth, Backup Camera, and Premium Wheels.'). Use features to match buyer priorities (safety, convenience, comfort).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fuel type and MPG
rubrics_metrics.description: Fuel type options: gas and hybrid. MPG examples provided (e.g., '2019 Toyota Camry L gets a combined 34 MPG', '2019 Toyota Camry Hybrid LE gets an estimated 52 MPG'). Per-listing MPG (e.g., '28/39 MPG', '51/53 MPG').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fuel economy is both a per-listing spec and a general FAQ item; used to compare operating cost and environmental efficiency between trims and powertrains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trim and model designation
rubrics_metrics.description: Trim levels shown per listing (examples: LE, SE, XLE, XSE, XSE V6, Hybrid LE/SE/XLE/XSE, TRD V6) and explicit 'Max year: 2019 / Min year: 2019' filters for the page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trim identifies equipment and performance differences; the page lists popular trims and counts (e.g., SE, LE, Hybrid LE) and provides MSRP ranges by trim in the FAQ. Use trim to narrow searches to desired equipment/performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seller / dealer information and VIN
rubrics_metrics.description: Each listing shows seller/dealer name and location, and VIN (e.g., VIN: 4T1B11HK1KU213306).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dealer identity and VIN are given to verify provenance, run independent history checks, or contact the seller. Location allows sorting by Distance and filtering by including/excluding non-local listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sorting and search controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Sort By options: Best Match, Best Deal, Price Low to High, Price High to Low, Distance, Mileage Low to High, Mileage High to Low, Year Low to High, Year High to Low, Newly Listed, Sponsored. Filters include Price range, Distance (ZIP + search radius), Vehicle Condition, Mileage, Features, Transmission, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controls determine which listings are surfaced; 'Best Match' and 'Best Deal' are site-defined heuristics. Use filters + sorting to tailor results to price, features, proximity, and recency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventory and availability statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Aggregate metrics: 'TrueCar has 71 used 2019 Toyota Camry models for sale in Seattle, WA', nationwide listings by year table showing 'Vehicle Price From', 'Certified Pre-Owned', 'Under 100k Miles', 'Accident Free', 'Total Available' per model year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides market context (supply, typical price by year, prevalence of CPO/accident-free/low-mileage units). Useful for assessing scarcity and pricing expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Owner reviews and subratings
rubrics_metrics.description: Owner review structure: Overall Rating (e.g., 4.4 out of 5 or 9 out of 10) with subratings: Performance, Comfort, Fuel Efficiency, Safety Technology, Features. Reviews include free-text 'pros' and 'cons' comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregated user ratings and qualitative pros/cons help evaluate real-world satisfaction and common issues (e.g., pros: fuel efficiency; cons: limited visibility, non-user-friendly apps). Use subratings to weigh specific attributes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vehicle descriptors / pros & cons summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Page-level Pros & Cons summary for the 2019 Camry: Pros — 'Powerful V6 engine. Great hybrid fuel economy. Standard adaptive cruise control and lane departure warning.' Cons — 'Some competitors have more cargo space. Missing Android Auto.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise expert-style summary of strengths/weaknesses to help buyers evaluate fit against priorities (performance, economy, tech, cargo).

rubrics_metrics.name: Body style and transmission availability
rubrics_metrics.description: FAQ: 'The used 2019 Toyota Camry comes in a sedan body style. 2019 Toyota Camry listings also offer automatic and manual transmissions.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies allowed body styles and transmissions to set expectations when filtering and comparing listings.
